body.message:
Your original 30-night booking rate was AED 5,500.

As you will be checking out on 26th July, your stay will be for a total of 21 nights (from 5th July to 26th July). The applicable amount for the 21-night stay will be AED 3,849.99.

The remaining balance of AED 1,650.01, which corresponds to the unused 9 nights, will be transferred and applied towards your future booking starting from 15th August.

We will also use the same security deposit amount for your future booking.
